definitions.stale: Positive evidence it no longer waits on the operator: every Action it targets is done in a Plan, or an explicit Supersedes line.
definitions.nonStaleClassifiable: Still live: the Ask names Action(s) that are not all done, or the Decision names an Action; no staleness evidence.
definitions.unclassifiable: Cannot be judged stale from checked-in evidence: an Ask whose intent names no Action, or a Decision naming no Action. Kept out of the list.
definitions.otherProjects: Items of other Projects need their own Project's Decision; naming that as the revival trigger for them.
